• A true revival changes
the way people live

• It changes how husbands
treat their wives

• It changes how wives
treat their husbands

• It changes how parents
raise their children

• It changes how young
people make decisions

• It changes how people
conduct business
• It changes how we treat the poor

• It changes how we respond
to those who disagree with us

• It changes our
attitudes toward sin

• It changes our commitment
to prayer and Scripture

spiritual awakening should
make us more like Jesus

more compassionate, more

committed to righteousness

revival is not merely how
loudly people shout in church,

for Jesus when they leave church!

different directions to meet at a

while the world waits to hear
the primary message of salvation!

church, and even a nation

these keys for another

• We need revival in our pulpits

in our own hearts

that can change the hearts of its people
